| **Scarff Compensation Lawyers** | Independent WA compensation firm specialising in workers’ compensation and other injury claims; currently showing a 5.0/5 local rating from 46 reviews. | **Peninsula Personal Injury Lawyers North Perth** | Strong client-review profile; LawConnect currently lists Peninsula among its highest-rated WA workers’ compensation practices at 4.9/5 from 182 reviews. [lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/workers-compensation/wa?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Strong reviews / personal injury claims** |
| **LHD Lawyers Perth** | Large established personal-injury practice with a strong review profile and experience across workplace injury and compensation claims. [lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/workers-compensation/wa/perth-6000?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Larger firm / broader compensation matters** |


### 🏆 If it were my claim

I'd probably speak to **three firms before choosing**:

1. **Anvil Legal** — my first call if the matter is specifically a workers’ compensation dispute.
2. **Stephen Browne Lawyers** — particularly if the injury is serious or the claim is becoming complicated.
3. **Perth City Legal** — attractive if you want a smaller, highly specialised Perth practice and direct attention from the legal team.

There is also an important distinction between **workers’ compensation** and a potential **common-law damages claim**. If your injury is serious, the lawyer you choose should assess both rather than simply helping with weekly payments and medical expenses.

One useful independent resource is **Circle Green Community Legal's Perth workers' compensation lawyer list**, which was reviewed in June 2026. It specifically identifies private firms/practitioners who practise in WA workers' compensation law, while noting that inclusion isn't an endorsement. [circlegreen.org.au](https://circlegreen.org.au/resource/workers-compensation-lawyer-list/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me what happened to you (e.g. back injury, psychological injury, rejected claim, employer dispute, permanent impairment, etc.), I can narrow this down to the 2–3 Perth lawyers I'd recommend for your particular situation and compare their fees/reviews.**

There is also an important distinction between **workers’ compensation** and a potential **common-law damages claim**. If your injury is serious, the lawyer you choose should assess both rather than simply helping with weekly payments and medical expenses.
